Name: En-gannim
ModernLocation: Unknown; two towns share the name, one in Judah and one in Issachar
Description: The name belongs to two towns: one in Judah's lowland and one in Issachar's allotment. Both appear only in the allotment lists, and neither site is identified.
BiblicalSignificance: En-gannim, spring of gardens, is shared by a Judah town and an Issachar town.
